item.title: ANÁLISIS El aumento de la deuda de las empresas de IA pone a prueba a los inversionistas
item.description: La oleada de emisiones de deuda destinadas a financiar la expansión de la inteligencia artificial está poniendo a prueba los límites de la demanda de los inversionistas, y algunos grandes compradores de bonos advierten de que el mercado está mostrando señales de saturación.
item.dc:creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
item.content:encoded: La oleada de emisiones de deuda destinadas a financiar la expansión de la inteligencia artificial está poniendo a prueba los límites de la demanda de los inversionistas, y algunos grandes compradores de bonos advierten de que el mercado está mostrando señales de saturación. Si bien los gestores de fondos siguen confiando en la calidad crediticia de empresas como Amazon (AMZN.O) y Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , la matriz de Google, cada vez exigen rendimientos más altos para hacer frente a la avalancha de emisiones. Esto ha suscitado la preocupación de que pueda haber un punto de inflexión si el gasto en IA sigue aumentando. "Se ha comenzado a ver esta 'indigestión' especialmente en los diferenciales de los bonos tecnológicos", dijo Neil Sutherland, responsable de renta fija estadounidense en Schroders. El diferencial de los bonos corporativos del sector tecnológico son el rendimiento adicional que exigen los inversionistas por mantener su deuda frente a los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos: mientras mayores más percepción de riesgo y mientras menores, más confianza. "En realidad, no se trata de un problema de solvencia en el caso de las empresas tecnológicas de mayor calidad, como Amazon y Google. Pero cuanto más tienen que emitir bonos, más exigen los inversionistas una prima para absorber esa deuda". Los analistas mencionaron la reciente emisión de bonos de largo plazo de Amazon, por valor de 25.000 millones de dólares, que se colocó unos 120 puntos básicos sobre el rendimiento de la deuda del Tesoro de Estados Unidos. El año pasado, el diferencial habría sido más o menos la mitad, señalaron. "El sector tecnológico ha pasado de cotizar sustancialmente en línea con el mercado a cotizar, de hecho, con diferenciales más amplios que el mercado", dijo Sutherland. "Los diferenciales más altos... hacen que otros sectores del mercado parezcan más caros en términos de valor relativo". Alphabet no quiso hacer comentarios y Amazon no respondió a una solicitud. Los diferenciales del sector tecnológico se sitúan actualmente en 89 puntos básicos, 9 puntos básicos más que el mercado general de deuda con calificación de inversión, según Karen Choi, gestora de carteras de Capital Group. La ampliación refleja un cambio importante para un sector que, históricamente, disfrutaba de algunos de los diferenciales más bajos del crédito corporativo debido a sus sólidos balances y a unas necesidades de financiación relativamente modestas. El auge de los bonos relacionados con la inteligencia artificial, en un momento en el que los Gobiernos siguen realizando un gasto considerable, ha sido un factor determinante en el aumento de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro, ya que los compradores exigen mayores rendimientos para seguir adquiriendo la avalancha de deuda que inunda los mercados. Cualquier retroceso en la emisión de bonos tecnológicos podría favorecer a los papeles del Tesoro de más largo plazo. MAYORES EXIGENCIAS George Catrambone, director de renta fija para América en DWS, dijo que los inversionistas están empezando a exigir mayores concesiones a medida que los volúmenes de emisión alcanzan récords. La emisión de deuda de los llamados hiperescaladores de IA ha alcanzado los 220.000 millones de dólares en 2026, según los últimos datos de BNP Paribas al 10 de agosto, o unos 207.000 millones de dólares más que en el mismo periodo del año pasado, cuando llegó a 12.500 millones de dólares. Los analistas señalaron que la emisión de bonos de Alphabet este mes tuvo una buena acogida, pero que aun así requirió una concesión de entre 10 y 15 puntos básicos respecto de los bonos ya emitidos. "La emisión de enero, en comparación con la de agosto, presenta un panorama diferente", señaló Catrambone, señalando que está cundiendo el cansancio. A principios de año, las operaciones relacionadas con la IA se absorbieron sin apenas resistencia por parte de los inversionistas, pero las transacciones recientes han necesitado un mayor rendimiento para salir adelante, lo que sugiere que los más tradicionales se han mostrado cautos por los diferenciales y vencimientos actuales. Catrambone también señaló que el mercado de bonos con calificación de inversión ha experimentado un cambio importante. Las empresas que antes tenían necesidades de financiación más reducidas y emitían principalmente deuda a corto plazo están ahora asumiendo importes de endeudamiento mucho mayores y emitiendo más bonos a largo plazo para ayudar a financiar el gasto relacionado con la IA. Esto ha dado lugar a una gama más amplia de bonos con diferentes vencimientos. Aun así, los inversionistas dicen que, por el momento, la situación no es alarmante. Según los analistas, las grandes empresas de tecnología siguen contando con sólidas calificaciones crediticias y disponen de flujos de caja sustanciales. Sin embargo, la dinámica de la oferta está empezando a pesar más que los fundamentos, especialmente en lo que respecta a los precios de las emisiones de bonos. Choi, de Capital Group, señaló que, hasta ahora, los inversionistas extranjeros, los fondos de pensiones y las compañías de seguros han absorbido parte de la emisión relacionada con la IA. El índice de bonos corporativos con calificación de inversión ofrece actualmente un rendimiento en torno al 5,4%, en línea con las medias a largo plazo, lo que contribuye a sostener la demanda. LÍMITES PRÁCTICOS El mayor riesgo, sin embargo, puede tener menos que ver con la demanda general y más con los límites prácticos a los que se enfrentan las carteras institucionales. "Depende realmente de cuánta deuda pueda absorber este mercado", señaló Choi. Muchos inversores de fondos de pensiones y aseguradoras limitan su exposición a emisores individuales a entre el 2% y el 3% de sus activos, añadió. A medida que el mismo puñado de empresas de IA emite deuda de forma repetida, esos límites cobran cada vez más importancia. El riesgo aumenta especialmente si el endeudamiento sigue concentrándose al principio del periodo. Choi señaló que la diversificación es importante para los clientes y que muchos "no quieren abrir un extracto y descubrir que poseen el 10% de un bono", lo que pone de relieve las restricciones de las carteras que, a la larga, podrían limitar la demanda. Tras años disfrutando de una demanda aparentemente ilimitada por parte de los inversionistas en bonos, las firmas tecnológicas se están dando cuenta de que el mercado se pregunta ahora cuánto está dispuesto a pagar para financiar la carrera de la IA. "No es un cheque en blanco", dijo Catrambone, de DWS. "Si estas empresas siguen recurriendo al mercado una y otra vez, las concesiones serán cada vez mayores y los diferenciales se ampliarán".

item.title: Apple pagou 40% de seus impostos globais à Irlanda no último ano fiscal
item.description: A Apple pagou US$17,1 bilhões em impostos à Irlanda no ano passado, valor que representou cerca de 40% do total de tributos pagos pela empresa em todo o mundo, segundo um documento da companhia que detalhou suas obrigações fiscais globais país por país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Apple pagou US$17,1 bilhões em impostos à Irlanda no ano passado, valor que representou cerca de 40% do total de tributos pagos pela empresa em todo o mundo, segundo um documento da companhia que detalhou suas obrigações fiscais globais país por país. A Apple afirmou que o valor pago à Irlanda foi "significativamente superior" ao imposto de renda devido, pois incluía 13 bilhões de euros (US$15,18 bilhões) em impostos retroativos que a empresa foi obrigada a pagar ao país por determinação da mais alta corte da União Europeia em 2024. A Irlanda lutou ao lado da Apple contra a cobrança retroativa de impostos da UE durante oito anos, buscando defender sua posição como destino preferencial das multinacionais norte-americanas na Europa -- e os bilhões de euros em impostos diretos e indiretos que elas geram anualmente. Em 2016, a então chefe da área da concorrência da Comissão Europeia, Margrethe Vestager, acusou a Irlanda de ter concedido benefícios fiscais ilegais à Apple, desviando injustamente investimentos de outros países. A Apple pagou US$43,2 bilhões em impostos de renda em todo o mundo no ano fiscal que terminou em setembro de 2025. (Reportagem de Graham Fahy)

item.title: Volkswagen precisa de cortes profundos para se manter competitiva, diz o CEO
item.description: O presidente-executivo da Volkswagen , Oliver Blume, alertou nesta sexta-feira que os problemas do setor automotivo só irão se intensificar nos próximos anos e que cortes profundos de custos são necessários para manter a principal montadora europeia competitiva.
item.dc:creator: Christina Amann
item.content:encoded: O presidente-executivo da Volkswagen , Oliver Blume, alertou nesta sexta-feira que os problemas do setor automotivo só irão se intensificar nos próximos anos e que cortes profundos de custos são necessários para manter a principal montadora europeia competitiva. Os comentários, feitos em um memorando interno da empresa visto pela Reuters, surgem em um momento em que a Volkswagen está passando pelo que é considerada a sua maior reestruturação de todos os tempos, que pode incluir desde novos cortes de 50.000 empregos até a separação de algumas divisões. Pressionada pela agressiva concorrência chinesa que se expande para a Europa, pela queda nos lucros na China e pelas pesadas tarifas de importação nos Estados Unidos, a Volkswagen enfrenta dificuldades com a queda nos lucros e o excesso de capacidade dispendioso na Europa. "A situação é mais do que crítica", disse Blume no memorando, acrescentando que, embora as margens atuais de menos de 4% sejam sólidas no ambiente atual, "elas não são de forma alguma suficientes para gerar fundos suficientes a longo prazo para novas tecnologias, novos produtos e nossas instalações". Blume, que na próxima semana visitará as fábricas da Volkswagen em risco no âmbito do atual plano de reestruturação, afirmou que os custos indiretos da montadora alemã continuam mais de 30% superiores aos de empresas comparáveis, acrescentando que essa situação precisa ser combatida para que a empresa se mantenha competitiva. O conselho de supervisão da Volkswagen tem reunião marcada para 4 de setembro para dar continuidade à discussão sobre os planos de reestruturação, segundo fontes familiarizadas com o assunto. Embora o grupo não tenha quantificado oficialmente o número de cortes adicionais de empregos, fontes disseram à Reuters que podem chegar a 50.000, o que dobraria efetivamente as demissões em massa planejadas pelo grupo. "O número frequentemente citado de cerca de 50.000 empregos em todo o mundo não é uma meta fixa", disse Blume, acrescentando que foi derivado do objetivo de custo da empresa em relação à concorrência e serviu "como um indicador da escala de ação necessária". Em julho, a Volkswagen revelou planos para reduzir drasticamente sua linha de modelos e diminuir ainda mais sua capacidade produtiva. No início deste mês, as famílias controladoras da VW aumentaram a pressão sobre todas as partes interessadas e exigiram esforços drásticos de reestruturação. Quatro fábricas da Volkswagen na Alemanha — Emden, Hannover, Zwickau e Neckarsulm — não devem atingir níveis competitivos de utilização da capacidade produtiva na década de 2030, afirmou Blume. Ele, porém, ressaltou que ainda não há nenhuma decisão sobre o fechamento de fábricas específicas. Segundo ele, houve progressos em algumas áreas, mas ainda não é suficiente, mesmo sem considerar a pressão dos novos concorrentes da China e suas fábricas na Europa. (Reportagem de Christina Amann)

item.title: Orlando City loan M Colin Guske to Real Salt Lake
item.description: Orlando City loaned 19-year-old midfielder Colin Guske to Real Salt Lake for the remainder of the 2026 season, both clubs announced Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Orlando City loaned 19-year-old midfielder Colin Guske to Real Salt Lake for the remainder of the 2026 season, both clubs announced Friday. The Lions receive $50,000 in general allocation money in the deal, while RSL holds an option to make the trade permanent at the end of the loan. "Orlando City has been my home for a long time, and I'm thankful to everyone ... who has supported me throughout my journey," he said. "I'm grateful for the opportunity to continue my development through this move and for the trust the Club has shown in helping me take this next step. My focus is on improving every day, earning opportunities on the field and helping the team however I can. I'm excited and looking forward to this next challenge." Guske has appeared in 16 matches for Orlando City across all competitions since signing a first-team contract as a homegrown player in December 2024. He has shined in the MLS NEXT Pro ranks, earning All-Star honors in 2024 and contributing one goal and four assists in 46 games (45 starts) for Orlando City B. Real Salt Lake (8-7-4, 28 points) will visit Orlando City (6-11-3, 21 points) on Saturday night. --Field Level Media

item.title: Whitecaps acquire D Sebastian Ramirez on loan
item.description: The Vancouver Whitecaps acquired defender Sebastian Ramirez from Colombia's Fortaleza on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Vancouver Whitecaps acquired defender Sebastian Ramirez from Colombia's Fortaleza on Friday. The deal for the 20-year-old Colombian center-back runs through June 2027 and includes a purchase option. "Sebastian is a young, defensively minded player who has emerged as a key contributor for Fortaleza," Whitecaps sporting director Axel Schuster said. "He brings a strong balance of aggression and awareness to defensive situations, while also offering versatility across multiple positions. We're excited to welcome Sebastian to the group and look forward to supporting his continued development." Ramirez recorded three goals in 46 appearances (26 starts) across all competitions with Fortaleza. "I'm very excited to have arrived at Whitecaps FC, it is a great opportunity for me to grow and I'm looking forward to giving my best to help the team," he said. "I know I am joining a club that strives to win, so I will work hard to help this team win titles and bring joy to the fans in this city." --Field Level Media

item.title: Integrantes da Otan discutem opções para Estreito de Ormuz sem envolvimento da aliança
item.description: O comandante-chefe da Otan convocou uma videoconferência nesta semana para facilitar possíveis contribuições em apoio à liberdade de navegação no Estreito de Ormuz, informou seu porta-voz à Reuters, acrescentando que não se trata de uma missão da Otan.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O comandante-chefe da Otan convocou uma videoconferência nesta semana para facilitar possíveis contribuições em apoio à liberdade de navegação no Estreito de Ormuz, informou seu porta-voz à Reuters, acrescentando que não se trata de uma missão da Otan. “O Quartel-General Supremo das Potências Aliadas na Europa (Shape) organizou uma reunião com os aliados interessados, no nível de chefes de defesa, na quarta-feira, 19 de agosto de 26, a fim de facilitar suas possíveis contribuições para apoiar a liberdade de navegação no Estreito de Ormuz”, disse nesta sexta-feira um porta-voz do comandante-chefe da aliança, o general da Força Aérea dos EUA Alexus Grynkewich. “Para deixar claro, esta não é uma missão da Otan. Mas, dada a capacidade única da Otan de reunir os aliados e compreender os recursos que eles podem mobilizar, faz sentido que a Otan atue como facilitadora dessa forma”, acrescentou o porta-voz. Os aliados da Otan têm procurado evitar o envolvimento direto no conflito com o Irã, concentrando-se, em vez disso, em planos fora da aliança para reabrir o estreito, que, antes de fevereiro, transportava cerca de um quinto de todo o petróleo comercializado. A França e o Reino Unido têm liderado os esforços para formar uma coalizão de cerca de uma dúzia de países a fim de garantir a passagem segura pelo estreito assim que as tensões diminuírem ou o conflito for resolvido, embora qualquer acordo de longo prazo exija, em última instância, a aquiescência iraniana.

item.title: Guyanesa Birkett lidera encuesta informal para Secretaría General de la ONU
item.description: Una encuesta informal realizada el viernes situaba a la guyanesa Carolyn Rodrigues Birkett ligeramente por delante en la carrera por convertirse en la próxima secretaria general de la ONU, según diplomáticos y otras fuentes cercanas al proceso.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Una encuesta informal realizada el viernes situaba a la guyanesa Carolyn Rodrigues Birkett ligeramente por delante en la carrera por convertirse en la próxima secretaria general de la ONU, según diplomáticos y otras fuentes cercanas al proceso. La votación entre los 15 miembros del Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU fue la segunda "encuesta informal" de este tipo, después de que en una primera ronda celebrada del mes pasado la exvicepresidenta de Costa Rica Rebeca Grynspan se situó en cabeza. La nueva encuesta situó al argentino Rafael Grossi, director de la agencia nuclear de la ONU, de nuevo en tercer lugar. En las encuestas informales, de las que se esperan varias rondas, se pregunta a los miembros del Consejo de Seguridad, mediante voto secreto, si "apoyan", "no apoyan" o "no tienen opinión" sobre los candidatos. En la votación del viernes, Birkett obtuvo ocho votos de apoyo —uno menos que la última vez—, tres en contra y cuatro "sin opinión". Grynspan obtuvo siete votos a favor —frente a los 10 de la última vez—, cuatro en contra y cuatro "sin opinión". Grossi se mantuvo en siete votos a favor, pero recibió seis en contra —frente a los dos de la última vez— y dos de "sin opinión". Ocho candidatos compiten por suceder a Antonio Guterres, que dejará el cargo a finales de año tras dos mandatos de cinco años. Su sucesor se enfrenta a la tarea de revitalizar una organización en crisis, de prestigio en declive y sometida a la presión de seguir reformando lo que, según los críticos, es una burocracia inflada y costosa. La diplomática ecuatoriana Ivonne Baki, que se incorporó a la carrera esta misma semana y que en el pasado ha reivindicado el apoyo de Estados Unidos y ha reconocido públicamente su amistad con el presidente Donald Trump, obtuvo cero votos a favor, ocho en contra y siete de "sin opinión". En las primeras rondas de las encuestas informales se emiten papeletas idénticas, lo que permite a los diplomáticos ver los niveles generales de apoyo y oposición sin revelar si los votos negativos proceden de alguno de los cinco miembros permanentes del Consejo con derecho a veto —China, Francia, Rusia, el Reino Unido y Estados Unidos—, cuyo apoyo es vital. En una fase posterior, los cinco miembros permanentes usan papeletas de un color diferente que revelan si un candidato ha recibido un voto de "desaprobación" de alguno de ellos.

item.title: Ukraine-Au moins 15 morts dans une frappe russe sur un centre commercial
item.description: Au moins quinze personnes ont été tuées dans une attaque russe de drones visant un centre commercial, qui a également blessé plus de 130 personnes dans la ville ukrainienne de Kryvyi Rih, ont annoncé vendredi les autorités locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Au moins quinze personnes ont été tuées dans une attaque russe de drones visant un centre commercial, qui a également blessé plus de 130 personnes dans la ville ukrainienne de Kryvyi Rih, ont annoncé vendredi les autorités locales. L'attaque, qui s'est déroulée en plein jour dans la ville natale du président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky, a blessé 22 enfants, a rapporté le gouverneur régional Oleksandr Hanzha sur Telegram. "Il y a 29 personnes dans un état sérieux, dont un enfant", a-t-il dit, accompagnant sa publication d'un cliché montrant de la fumée s'échappant d'un bâtiment. Le président ukrainien a qualifié l'attaque "d'absolument cynique et ignoble", ajoutant qu'un deuxième drone russe avait frappé le centre commercial une demi-heure après la première salve, ce qu'il a présenté comme la volonté de la part de Moscou de s'en prendre aux services de secours. "Les attaques de ce genre ne sont rien de moins que des actes terroristes", a déclaré Volodimir Zelensky sur Telegram. "Nous allons définitivement répondre", a-t-il ajouté. Dans une attaque de drone russe distincte, quatre personnes, dont trois enfants, ont été tuées dans la région de Mykolaïv (sud), selon une agence de presse ukrainienne. Moscou a intensifié ses attaques sur l'Ukraine. Jeudi, 17 personnes ont trouvé la mort dans une attaque de missiles balistiques russes sur Kyiv. L'Ukraine cible de son côté les installations pétrolières et les infrastructures logistiques russes pour empêcher la Russie de mener sa guerre.

item.title: Lula, Trump discuss tariffs in phone call, Brazil says
item.description: Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and U.S. President Donald Trump spoke by phone on Friday and discussed tariffs Washington recently imposed on Brazilian goods, according to a statement from Brazil's government.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil's President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and U.S. President Donald Trump spoke by phone on Friday and discussed tariffs Washington recently imposed on Brazilian goods, according to a statement from Brazil's government. During the call, Lula reiterated that negotiations are the best way to resolve the dispute, while Trump suggested that officials from both countries meet as soon as possible, the statement said. The U.S. government announced [USN:FWN43H1K7 TEXT:"25% tariffs"] last month on some Brazilian goods, alleging unfair trade practices, as well as [USN:S0N42I03Z TEXT:"12.5% tariffs"] on goods from dozens of nations, including Brazil, linked to allegations of lax enforcement of forced labor bans. Lula said in the statement that the tariffs would harm both economies and that the allegations cited by Washington to justify the measures, including concerns over deforestation, intellectual property, corruption, Brazil's Pix instant payment system, ethanol and imports allegedly tied to forced labor, were unfounded. [USN:L6N44A1G3 TEXT:"Earlier this month"], Brazil started a process seeking further consultations with U.S. trade authorities, a move that could lead to measures against Washington. Lula reiterated in the call Brazil's interest in cooperating with the U.S. to combat organized crime, but said criminal gangs operating in Brazil should not be equated with terrorist organizations, the label [USN:L1N4251B8 TEXT:"Washington applied"] to two of them in May.

item.title: Wizards acquire G Tre Mann as part of 5-team trade
item.description: The Washington Wizards acquired guard Tre Mann from the Charlotte Hornets as part of a five-team trade.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Washington Wizards acquired guard Tre Mann from the Charlotte Hornets as part of a five-team trade. The Wizards also received a 2027 second-round pick from the Los Angeles Clippers as part of the deal on Thursday. Washington, in turn, sent Cam Whitmore to the Cleveland Cavaliers and fellow forward Juju Reese to the Denver Nuggets. Mann, 25, averaged 5.5 points, 1.7 rebounds and 1.6 assists in 53 games (one start) last season with Charlotte. He has contributed 8.5 points, 2.6 boards and 2.1 assists in 234 career games (60 starts) with the Oklahoma City Thunder and Hornets. Whitmore, 22, averaged 9.2 points and 2.8 rebounds in 21 games off the bench last season with the Wizards. He has averaged 10.5 points and 3.3 boards in 119 games (five starts) with the Houston Rockets and Wizards. Reese, 23, made his NBA debut last season and contributed 11.8 points and 10.5 rebounds in 13 games (10 starts) for Washington. --Field Level Media

item.title: US plans $725 million payment towards its large UN debt
item.description: The Trump administration has started the process to transfer $725 million to the United Nations, a congressional notification seen by Reuters showed, a move aid experts said was a welcome step towards paying billions in dues owed.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Emma Farge
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration has started the process to transfer $725 million to the United Nations, a congressional notification seen by Reuters showed, a move aid experts said was a welcome step towards paying billions in dues owed. There was no immediate response from Washington to questions about the reasons for the payment from an administration which has slashed funding to many U.N. agencies and [USN:L6N3VA0KJ TEXT:"blasted"] the global body for not living up to its potential. The money - mentioned in an August 4 State Department notification letter to Congress that has not been reported - is set to go through before an expected speech by U.S. President Donald Trump to the U.N. General Assembly in New York next month. 'IT KEEPS THE SHIP AFLOAT A LITTLE LONGER' U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres said this year that the U.N. faced "[USN:L6N3YV0SW TEXT:"imminent financial collapse"]" due to unpaid contributions from member states, and the global body has brought in large budget cuts. The $725 million would be less than 20% of the more than $4 billion that the U.N. said in May it was owed by the United States — though Washington has said that total figure [USN:L1N3ZF0SP TEXT:"is much lower"] and that it has made some payments. Eugene Chen, a former U.N. official, told Reuters such a transfer would help pay U.N. salaries for a period, but might not cover them all. "It keeps the ship afloat a little longer," he said. "If the U.S. does not make further payments it will likely lose its voting rights in January," he added. Under article 19 of the U.N. Charter, a member state loses its voting rights in the General Assembly if its arrears exceed two years in annual fees, although grace periods are possible. A significant transfer now could avert the need for immediate spending cuts, Ronny Patz, an expert in U.N. finance with German think tank IDOS, said. "If they pay a big chunk, the U.N. still runs on zero reserves but it gets through the year," Patz added. “If they don’t pay, the U.N. might really be in trouble for the last two or three months of the year in terms of paying salaries and keeping the doors open.” The U.S. is the biggest contributor to the U.N. budget, but under the Trump administration it has refused to make mandatory payments to regular and peacekeeping budgets, and has slashed voluntary funding to U.N. agencies with their own budgets. Washington [USN:L1N3Y8138 TEXT:"has also withdrawn from"] dozens of U.N. and other international agencies. The U.N. had been counting on collecting around 90% of dues from its 193 members for this year's budget, its Controller Chandramouli Ramanathan said last month. As of August 18, some 129 members had paid in full, a U.N. document showed. China, the number 2 contributor after Washington, was also absent from the list. The State Department said in its August 4 letter it was obligating a total of $725 million for the U.N.'s regular budget. The U.S. State Department and the U.S. diplomatic mission to the United Nations did not immediately respond to requests for comment by email on Friday. In May, the U.N. said the more than $4 billion owed to it by Washington included $2.04 billion for the regular budget, $2.2 billion for current and past peacekeeping missions, and $44 million for U.N. tribunals. Washington has not transferred around $153.4 million in what it calls "policy-based withholdings". That included $10.6 million meant for the Human Rights Council — which Washington disengaged from last year alleging an anti-Israel bias — and funds for the [USN:L1N3XF0SR TEXT:"U.N. Palestinian Refugee Agency"]. The 80-year-old institution has been undergoing a decisive reform and cost-cutting exercise known as "UN80" amid its financial crisis. It has already cut its 2026 budget by 9.2% and transferred over 2,000 jobs out of expensive cities like[USN:L1N41D1E4 TEXT:" Geneva"] and New York to lower-cost hubs.

US, Canadian trade teams meet again as tariffs deadline looms

By Greg Savoy WASHINGTON, Aug 21 (Reuters) – Top trade negotiators from Canada and the U.S. met for the third day running in Washington on Friday to try to finalize a trade deal before threatened new American tariffs come into effect on Saturday.

A deal could mark a detente in what has been 18 months of tense relations that started when President Donald Trump imposed tariffs on key imports from Canada, prompting Ottawa to retaliate with a suite of countermeasures.

Trump says he will impose a new 50% tariff on about $20 billion worth of Canadian goods at 12:01 a.m. EDT (0401 GMT) on Saturday if a deal is not reached.

Show Full Article

Canada’s minister responsible for trade with the U.S., Dominic LeBlanc, did not speak to reporters as he arrived for the talks.

LeBlanc met Greer for more than three hours on Thursday and said the two sides were “very close” to a deal, but added that more work was necessary.

Even if a deal is reached, Prime Minister Mark Carney could find it hard to sell it to Canadians and the influential premiers of the 10 provinces.

A Leger opinion poll showed on Wednesday that 56% of Canadians want Carney to make no further concessions.

Sources say an agreement is expected to cut the top-line tariff on Canadian-built vehicles to 15% from 25% and halve tariffs on Canadian steel and aluminum to 25%. Ontario, a major steel and aluminum producer, wants the tariffs scrapped.

Carney is calling on major provinces to rescind their ban on sales of U.S. alcohol, which is a major irritant for Washington.

Wab Kinew, the premier of Manitoba, on Thursday said Trump was “very weak” and Canada should take advantage.

“I think we’ve got the upper hand – they’re back on their heels right now. They’re coming to us for a deal, and so I think we should fight,” he told reporters.

Canada, though, is a tenth the size of the United States and sends around 70% of all exports south of the border, which makes it uniquely vulnerable to punitive U.S. trade actions.

U.S. Vice President JD Vance on Wednesday mocked Carney, saying he “comes in and puffs his chest out and says, ‘I’m going to, like, out-tough Donald Trump’.”

In a recording obtained by the Canadian Press, Vance can then be heard saying “It’s hilarious because Carney presents this as some victory for Canada when fundamentally, like, they climb down on a lot of issues.”

Vance was speaking at a fundraiser in Southampton, New York.

(Writing by David Ljunggren; Editing by Katharine Jackson, Philippa Fletcher and Sanjeev Miglani)

item.title: Volkswagen needs deep cuts to remain competitive, CEO says ahead of crunch talks
item.description: Volkswagen CEO Oliver Blume warned on Friday that the car sector’s problems would only intensify in the coming years, arguing deep cost cuts were needed to keep Europe’s top automaker afloat as it ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen CEO Oliver Blume warned on Friday that the car sector’s problems would only intensify in the coming years, arguing deep cost cuts were needed to keep Europe’s top automaker afloat as it gears up for weeks of crunch talks over a planned revamp. Blume’s comments, made in an internal company memo seen by Reuters, come as Volkswagen is undergoing what is considered to be its largest-ever restructuring, possibly ranging from a fresh 50,000 job cuts to the carve-out of some divisions. Squeezed by aggressive Chinese competition rushing to Europe, falling profits in China and painful import tariffs in the United States, Volkswagen is struggling with declining profits and costly overcapacity in Europe. “The situation is more than critical,” Blume said in the memo, adding that while current margins of less than 4 per cent were solid in the current environment “it is by no means sufficient to generate enough funds in the long term for new technologies, new products and our sites.” Blume, who will next week tour Volkswagen plants at risk under the current turnaround plan, said the German carmaker’s overhead costs remained more than 30 per cent higher than those of comparable firms, adding this had to be tackled to remain competitive. Volkswagen’s supervisory board is scheduled to meet on September 4 to continue its discussion on the turnaround plans, according to people familiar with the matter. While the group has not officially quantified the size of additional job cuts, sources have told Reuters it could be an additional 50,000, effectively doubling the group’s planned layoffs. “The frequently cited figure of around 50,000 jobs worldwide is not a fixed target,” Blume said, adding it was derived from the company’s cost objective relative to the competition and served “as an indicator of the scale of action required.” In July, Volkswagen unveiled plans to drastically cut its model lineup and further pare back capacity. The controlling families behind VW earlier this month dialed up the pressure on all stakeholders and demanded dramatic restructuring efforts. Four Volkswagen plants in Germany -- Emden, Hannover, Zwickau and Neckarsulm -- are not expected to reach competitive capacity utilization in the 2030s, Blume said, but stressed that there is no decision yet on specific plant closures. Sites have made progress in some areas, he said, but it is not yet enough, even without considering the pressure from new competitors from China and their plants in Europe. (Reporting by Christina Amann, Writing by Miranda Murray and Christoph Steitz; Editing by Ludwig Burger and Susan Fenton)

item.title: Root disappointed over Headingley missing out on Ashes test
item.description: England captain Joe Root expressed his disappointment on Friday that Headingley will not stage an Ashes test next year after leading his country to a crushing victory over Pakistan by an innings and 103 runs at his home ground.
item.dc:creator: Neil Squires
item.content:encoded: England captain Joe Root expressed his disappointment on Friday that Headingley will not stage an Ashes test next year after leading his country to a crushing [USN:L6N44I0T1 TEXT:"victory over Pakistan"] by an innings and 103 runs at his home ground. England have won their last seven tests in Leeds, including wins over Australia on their last two visits, and Root feels the ECB have missed a trick in choosing to overlook the ground. Lord’s, The Oval, Edgbaston, Trent Bridge and Southampton will stage Ashes tests next summer with England not down to play another men’s test at Headingley until 2029. “I’d love to play as many games as possible here. I think it’s a great test match venue,” said Root. “It’s a surface that provides brilliant test cricket and one that we’ve had quite a lot of success at recently, so it’s a shame that we don’t get to play here next year but I’m sure we’ll see many, many more brilliant test matches here. “As a player it would be nice to have a choice. It’s a ground that we generally do well at and we love playing here. As a Yorkshireman I sort of have to say that from birth.” Root was delighted with the manner of the victory over Pakistan in his first game since assuming the permanent captaincy role again. “It couldn’t have really gone better for us,” he said. “I’m just really pleased with our performance and the way we dealt with things out there.” Pakistan’s defeat was their ninth in their last 10 away matches. “We’re not playing well for sure when it comes to away series. We haven’t done well anywhere in the world and this is concerning,” said Pakistan stand-in captain Salman Ali Agha. “One thing I can say is we are trying and hopefully in the second game we can change that. We'll come back stronger."

item.title: GRANOS El maíz cotiza estable tras alcanzar su máximo en 18 meses
item.description: Los futuros del maíz en Chicago tenían un desempeño irregular el viernes, tras alcanzar en la sesión anterior un máximo en 18 meses, mientras los operadores asimilaban resultados decepcionantes de una gira de inspección de cultivos que suscitó dudas sobre el rendimiento de la cosecha estadounidense.
item.dc:creator: Heather Schlitz
item.content:encoded: Los futuros del maíz en Chicago tenían un desempeño irregular el viernes, tras alcanzar en la sesión anterior un máximo en 18 meses, mientras los operadores asimilaban resultados decepcionantes de una gira de inspección de cultivos que suscitó dudas sobre el rendimiento de la cosecha estadounidense. La soja también experimentaba altibajos el viernes, tras el repunte de principios de esta semana, debido a los resultados dispares de la visita de campo de Pro Farmer y a la racha continua de ventas de exportación a China. El trigo se mantenía estable mientras los operadores esperaban señales de que las interrupciones en las exportaciones de Rusia y Ucrania provocadas por la guerra lleven a los importadores a comprar en otros orígenes. El contrato de maíz más activo en la Bolsa de Chicago subía 3,25 centavos, a 5,0675 dólares por bushel, a las 1600 GMT, tras haber alcanzado el jueves su máximo desde febrero de 2025. La soja bajaba 0,25 centavos, a 12,3625 dólares por bushel. "Estamos a la espera de los resultados de la gira de inspección de cultivos; creo que nos enfrentamos a un rendimiento del maíz inferior al previsto por el Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA)", dijo Dan Smith, director de Top Third Ag Marketing. El mercado ha seguido de cerca los informes de la gira de campo de Pro Farmer porque el USDA ya había recortado la semana pasada sus previsiones de rendimiento para el maíz y la soja. Los inspectores encontraron el jueves, último día de la gira de cuatro días, cosechas excelentes en las zonas orientales de Iowa y Minnesota, pero nada que cuestione las expectativas de que la cosecha de maíz de este año en Estados Unidos no alcanzará el récord del año pasado. Unos rendimientos más bajos podrían reducir la oferta estadounidense en un momento de fuerte demanda de maíz y soja. La soja, en particular, se ha visto respaldada por la fuerte alza de los márgenes de molienda y el ritmo constante de compras por parte de China. El trigo cedía 2,5 centavos, a 6,975 dólares por bushel. Los importadores mundiales de trigo se preparan para una mayor escasez de oferta, ya que los ataques recíprocos de Rusia y Ucrania contra puertos y buques en las últimas semanas han provocado el cierre de terminales de cereales y han obligado a los transportistas a retrasar o cancelar la carga durante la temporada alta de exportación.

item.title: Ações sobem, mas preocupações com inflação levam a queda semanal
item.description: As ações europeias subiram nesta sexta-feira com os investidores focados em sinais de resiliência econômica, mas o índice de referência encerrou a semana em baixa com os preços elevados do petróleo e os rendimentos dos Treasuries mantendo vivas as preocupações com a inflação.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Utkarsh Hathi
item.content:encoded: As ações europeias subiram nesta sexta-feira com os investidores focados em sinais de resiliência econômica, mas o índice de referência encerrou a semana em baixa com os preços elevados do petróleo e os rendimentos dos Treasuries mantendo vivas as preocupações com a inflação. O índice pan-europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) fechou com alta de 0,59%, a 654,18 pontos, mas registrando perdas pela segunda semana consecutiva. Um salto nos rendimentos dos títulos de longo prazo dos Estados Unidos nesta semana inquietou os investidores globais e prejudicou o apetite por risco, antes que o Tesouro dos EUA anunciasse medidas para aumentar o suporte à liquidez, o que muitos consideraram uma solução temporária. No entanto, uma temporada de balanços sólida tem sustentado o apetite por risco na Europa, com a economia da região mostrando sinais de resiliência apesar do conflito no Oriente Médio devido à sua exposição limitada ao comércio de IA e a uma perspectiva mais clara da política monetária. A atividade empresarial da zona do euro está crescendo no ritmo mais acelerado deste ano graças a novos pedidos no setor manufatureiro e à retomada do crescimento das exportações, segundo dados divulgados na sexta-feira. O índice PMI Composto S&P Global para a zona do euro atingiu neste mês o maior nível desde novembro. Ainda assim, os investidores continuam cautelosos em tirar conclusão demais os dados recentes, dada a incerteza em relação à inflação. Entre os setores, as ações de luxo (.STXLUXP) subiram 1,4%, recuperando-se da queda na sessão anterior, enquanto os recursos básicos (.SXPP) lideraram os ganhos setoriais, subindo 2,5%, uma vez que o dólar mais fraco impulsionou os preços do ouro. Em LONDRES, o índice Financial Times (.FTSE) avançou 0,64%, a 10.816,56 pontos. Em FRANKFURT, o índice DAX (.GDAXI) subiu 0,59%, a 26.136,56 pontos. Em PARIS, o índice CAC-40 (.FCHI) ganhou 0,37%, a 8.484,43 pontos. Em MILÃO, o índice Ftse/Mib (.FTMIB) ficou estável, a 52.668,04 pontos. Em MADRI, o índice Ibex-35 (.IBEX) registrou alta de 0,76%, a 19.961,50 pontos. Em LISBOA, o índice PSI20 (.PSI20) valorizou-se 0,78%, a 9.354,78 pontos.

item.title: Norris still believes he can retain his F1 title
item.description: Lando Norris still believes he has a chance of successfully defending his Formula One title, even though he says he is not currently in the championship chase.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Lando Norris still believes he has a chance of successfully defending his Formula One title, even though he says he is not currently in the championship chase. The McLaren driver, who [USN:L6N44I0VZ TEXT:"qualified on the front row"] for Saturday's Dutch Grand Prix sprint race, starts the second half of the season in fifth position overall and a mighty 91 points behind Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli. With a maximum 12 rounds to go, and possibly only 11 if the last two Middle Eastern races have to be cancelled and replaced by one final European grand prix, closing the gap and overtaking the Italian looks a tall order. It is still mathematically possible, however, and Red Bull's four-times champion Max Verstappen came back from 104 points behind Norris' teammate Oscar Piastri at the end of August last season to finish just two points behind Norris. NOT STRESSED AT ALL "This year I don't feel stressed at all. I feel very relaxed," Norris told reporters before the track action started at Zandvoort. "For two reasons: One because of what I achieved last year and two because I'm not in the fight." Asked whether he really believed the latter part of that statement, given every racing driver's instinct to battle and hope even against the odds, Norris clarified his position. "Of course I'm in the fight. If you want to compare it to Max last season you can do. But I don't mean it that way. I'm just not first, second (place) in the championship. "Max didn't think he was in the fight at this point last season. So it's more just the saying of that. "I still believe it's possible ... there's still a chance. And if there's a chance, then I want to fight for it." Norris qualified second for the grand prix at Zandvoort last year, when the sprint format was not used, but retired from the race and was left 34 points behind Piastri. That remains the Australian's most recent win in Formula One, with Norris then reeling him in over the rest of the campaign. Norris, who celebrated McLaren's [USN:L6N43S048 TEXT:"first win of the season"] in Hungary last month, said at no point this year had he felt his situation was impossible, even if hope was thin on the ground. "There's been not many reasons to believe why it is possible until Budapest," he said. "So obviously now it's a more genuine question."

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS L'Europe finit dans le vert, l'obligataire et la géopolitique restent un frein
item.description: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en hausse vendredi, retrouvant un peu de couleur après une série de séances tendues en raison de la hausse mondiale du coût de la dette publique et de l'absence de progrès diplomatiques au Moyen-Orient.
item.dc:creator: Diana Mandia
item.content:encoded: Les Bourses européennes ont terminé en hausse vendredi, retrouvant un peu de couleur après une série de séances tendues en raison de la hausse mondiale du coût de la dette publique et de l'absence de progrès diplomatiques au Moyen-Orient. À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) a gagné 0,37% à 8.484,43 points. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) a pris 0,56% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) a progressé de 0,64%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) a fini sur un gain de 0,56%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) de 0,53% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,51%. Sur la semaine, le Stoxx 600 abandonne en revanche 0,64% et le CAC 40 1,76%. Les tensions sur les marchés obligataires mondiaux ne montrent guère de signes d'apaisement, les rendements des bons du Trésor américain repartant à la hausse malgré un bref répit induit par l'annonce des États-Unis de son intention d'acheter davantage de dette à long terme. Le déficit budgétaire de la première économie mondiale dépasse les 6% du produit intérieur brut (PIB), les paiements d'intérêts s'élevant à eux seuls à 1.200 milliards de dollars cette année, tandis que la dette vient de franchir la barre des [USN:L6N44G191 TEXT:"40.000 milliards"] de dollars. Cet endettement sans précédent touche également d'autres grandes économies mondiales, notamment l'Allemagne et la France, où les rendements de leurs obligations à long terme respectives ont également atteint cette semaine des sommets inégalés depuis bien plus d'une décennie. Les rendements des OAT françaises à 10 ans ont augmenté à un rythme plus rapide que leurs pairs allemandes, portant le "spread" à plus de 87 points de base ce vendredi en séance, un écart qui pourrait encore se creuser à mesure que le débat budgétaire s'intensifie à la rentrée. Même si ce n'est pas le seul facteur, les anticipations d'inflation constituent un élément essentiel des turbulences sur le marché obligataire, l'impasse diplomatique dans le Golfe installant les cours du pétrole au-delà des 90 dollars le baril, avec la navigation dans le détroit d'Ormuz [USN:L6N44I06E TEXT:"fortement perturbée"]. Selon le secrétaire américain au Trésor, Scott Bessent, les Etats-Unis vont imposer "les sanctions les plus sévères de l'histoire" contre l'Iran, qui a répondu vendredi que sa riposte à toute nouvelle menace américaine serait "dévastatrice". "Une recrudescence des incidents maritimes et des mesures de rétorsion contre les sanctions économiques pourraient aggraver la situation actuelle, alors que le trafic dans le détroit d'Ormuz reste bien en deçà des niveaux habituels", a averti Crispus Nyaga, analyste chez Empire FX. Les investisseurs ont par ailleurs devant eux une semaine très chargée, avec la publication du rapport sur l'inflation PCE aux États-Unis et le symposium de Jackson Hole à l'ordre du jour des responsables de la politique monétaire. Un autre temps fort des prochains jours sera la publication des résultats du fabricant de puces d'IA Nvidia (NVDA.O) , prévue mercredi. VALEURS Les ressources de base (.SXPP) se sont distinguées vendredi parmi les secteur du Stoxx 600, progressant de 2,57% grâce à la hausse des cours de l'or, dans un contexte de faiblesse du dollar américain. Les producteurs d'acier ont également connu une séance favorable, ArcelorMittal terminant sur un gain de 2,3%. A WALL STREET Les principaux indices américains sont dans le vert après les fortes baisses enregistrées la veille sur fond de tensions dans le marché de la dette souveraine. A l'heure de la clôture en Europe, le Dow Jones (.DJI) gagne 0,76%, le Standard & Poor's 500 (.SPX) 0,53% et le Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) 0,49%. Aux valeurs, la plateforme destinée aux investisseurs particuliers Robinhood (HOOD.O) prend plus de 12% et l'opérateur de crypto-bourses Coinbase Global (COIN.O) 9%, soutenus par l'appréciation du bitcoin , qui a atteint vendredi son plus haut niveau depuis mai. LES INDICATEURS DU JOUR La séance a été riche en indicateurs, notamment en Europe. L'activité du secteur privé dans la zone euro [USN:ZRN00EEK5 TEXT:"a enregistré"] en août sa plus forte progression depuis novembre, soutenue par une hausse des nouvelles commandes, notamment dans le secteur manufacturier, et par un retour à la croissance des exportations, montre l'enquête préliminaire sur les directeurs d'achat (PMI). La confiance des consommateurs du bloc s'est pour sa part légèrement améliorée depuis le début du mois, selon les [USN:L8N44I0SK TEXT:"résultats préliminaires"] de l'enquête mensuelle de la Commission européenne. En France, en revanche, l'activité [USN:ZRN00EEJR TEXT:"s'est contractée"] plus fortement que prévu, les récentes vagues de chaleur ayant pesé sur le secteur prédominant des services. Au Royaume-Uni, le secteur des services, moteur de l'économie du pays, a connu une reprise inattendue en août, qui vient s'ajouter aux signes de résilience observés outre-Manche malgré le conflit au Moyen-Orient. CHANGES Le dollar réduit ses pertes (-0,02%) face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tout en restant proche de son plus bas niveau depuis trois mois face à l'euro, les investisseurs se demandant si les efforts déployés par le Trésor américain pour apaiser les marchés obligataires ne risquaient pas de saper la confiance dans la devise. L'euro cède 0,03 à 1,1674 dollar . Le [USN:L6N44I0SD TEXT:"bitcoin"] grimpe de plus de 6% à 77.539 dollars, porté par la décision du Trésor américain de doubler le montant de ses rachats d'obligations et alors que le président américain a exhorté le Congrès à adopter un projet de loi favorable aux les cryptomonnaies. TAUX Les rendements des obligations américaine progressent vendredi, l'effet des annonces du Trésor s'estompant, tandis qu'une série de données publiées vendredi montrent une forte expansion du secteur des services aux États-Unis ce mois-ci. Le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans avance de 3,8 points de base à 4,7359%, tandis que celui du titre à deux ans prend 5,5 points de base à 4,2401%. Dans la zone euro, les rendements ont fini sur la séance sur une note plus stable, celui du Bund allemand à dix ans progressant à peine pour s'établir à 3,2561%. Celui de l'obligation à deux ans a fini à 2,8378%. En France, le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans a pris 1,4 points de base à 4,1311%. Celui du titre à 30 ans a terminé sur un gain d'environ 2 points de base, à 4,91%. PÉTROLE L'incertitude liée au conflit au Moyen-Orient continue d'affecter les marchés de l'énergie. Le Brent avance de 0,28% à 94,04 dollars le baril, s'orientant à un gain hebdomadaire de plus de 6%, tandis que le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) cède 0,22% à 86,64 dollars. A SUIVRE LE 24 AOÛT: L8N43Q1NY (Certaines données peuvent accuser un léger décalage)

item.title: NATO members discuss Strait of Hormuz options without alliance involvement
item.description: NATO's top commander convened a videoconference earlier this week to facilitate possible contributions to support freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, his spokesperson told Reuters, adding that this is not a NATO mission.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: NATO's top commander convened a videoconference earlier this week to facilitate possible contributions to support freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, his spokesperson told Reuters, adding that this is not a NATO mission. “Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe hosted a meeting of interested Allies at the chief of defence level on Wednesday, 19 Aug 26, in order to facilitate their possible contributions to support freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz," a spokesperson for the alliance's top commander U.S. Air Force General Alexus Grynkewich said on Friday. "To be clear, this is not a NATO mission. But given NATO’s unique strengths in its ability to bring together Allies and understand the capabilities they bring to bear, it makes sense for NATO to facilitate in this way," the spokesperson added. NATO allies have sought to avoid direct involvement in the Iran conflict, instead focusing on plans outside the alliance to reopen the strait, which before February carried about a fifth of all traded oil. France and Britain have led efforts to build a coalition among roughly a dozen countries to guarantee safe passage through the strait once tensions ease or the conflict is resolved, though any long-term arrangement would ultimately require Iranian acquiescence.

item.title: ベラルーシ、フィンランドの大使館を閉鎖へ 9月1日付
item.description: ［ヘルシンキ ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ヘルシンキ　２１日　ロイター］ - ベラルーシ政府が採択した決議で２１日、同国がフィンランドの大使館を９月１日付で閉鎖することが明らかになった。

フィンランド外務省は、ベラルーシから閉鎖の通知を受けたと明らかにし、同国が今後どのように外交代表機能を維持するかについては確認を待っている状況だと述べた。

在フィンランド・ベラルーシ大使館のコメントは得られていない。

item.title: Lula e Trump conversaram por telefone e discutem tarifas
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva conversou nesta sexta-feira com o presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, informou o Palácio do Planalto, no primeiro contato entre ambos desde que os Estados Unidos decidiram adotar novas tarifas contra os produtos brasileiros.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva conversou nesta sexta-feira com o presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, informou o Palácio do Planalto, no primeiro contato entre ambos desde que os Estados Unidos decidiram adotar novas tarifas contra os produtos brasileiros. De acordo com nota divulgada pela Presidência da República, no telefonema, de uma hora e 20 minutos, Lula questionou as novas tarifas, reafirmando que se baseavam em "alegações infundadas" e que afetavam negativamente tanto os consumidores brasileiros quanto os norte-americanos. "O presidente Trump concordou com a necessidade de preservar vínculos comerciais fortes e propôs que equipes dos dois países voltassem a se reunir o mais brevemente possível", diz a nota. O governo dos EUA adotou em julho tarifas de 25% sobre cerca de 4 mil produtos brasileiros, de acordo com um levantamento feito pelo Ministério do Desenvolvimento, Indústria, Comércio e Serviços (MDIC), o que equivale a cerca de 18% das exportações para aquele país. A base da decisão norte-americana foi uma investigação sobre supostas práticas comerciais desleais, a chamada seção 301 da legislação comercial dos EUA, e que acusa o Brasil, entre outros pontos, de não controlar o desmatamento e dar vantagens ao Pix contra instrumentos de pagamentos norte-americanos. Poucos dias depois, os EUA também aplicaram uma tarifa de 12,5% alegando uma legislação fraca para combater o trabalho forçado. O Brasil rechaça todas as acusações. Este foi o quarto telefonema entre os dois presidentes desde setembro de 2025, quando ambos se encontraram e conversaram brevemente durante a Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas, em Nova York, no que foi o começo de uma relação até então hostil. No telefonema, segundo o Palácio do Planalto, os presidentes trataram também da cooperação que Lula quer com os EUA para combater o crime organizado e sobre as guerras na Ucrânia e no Oriente Médio. Lula tem feito uma série de conversas com presidentes dos países membros permanentes do Conselho de Segurança das Nações Unidas pedindo que ajam nessas questões, entre eles Vladimir Putin, da Rússia, e Xi Jinping, da China. "O presidente Trump teceu considerações sobre as perspectivas de resolução do conflito com o Irã. O presidente Lula lamentou a inoperância do Conselho de Segurança da ONU e, a exemplo do que sugerira aos presidentes Xi Jinping e Putin, propôs a convocação de uma reunião extraordinária do órgão para encontrar saídas diplomáticas para as crises atuais", diz a nota do Planalto.

item.title: Mexican governor accused by US of cartel ties returns to office
item.description: The governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state, Ruben Rocha Moya, returned to office on Friday after taking leave for more than three months following U.S. drug trafficking charges, a move likely to deepen strains between Mexico and the United States.
item.dc:creator: Kylie Madry, Diego Oré, Sarah Morland
item.content:encoded: The governor of Mexico's Sinaloa state, Ruben Rocha Moya, returned to office on Friday after taking leave for more than three months following [USN:S0N4040KF TEXT:"U.S. drug trafficking charges"], a move likely to deepen strains between Mexico and the United States. Rocha, 77, a member of Mexico's ruling Morena party, said in a statement posted on X that he was resuming his duties, and added that Mexican authorities found no evidence to support the accusations against him. The move appears to cap a remarkable turnaround for Rocha, who has not only avoided, for now, extradition to the United States but has now reclaimed the governor's office. It also exposes the limits of bilateral security cooperation: despite years of joint efforts against cartels, Mexico remains deeply resistant to U.S. actions it sees as encroaching on its sovereignty. In his statement on X, Rocha denied wrongdoing and cast the U.S. case as a politically motivated attack on Mexico's sovereignty and on the leftist movement led by President Claudia Sheinbaum. "I am innocent of the falsehoods that have been fabricated against me by representatives of the far right who sought, as is now fully evident, to damage the left-wing political movement to which I belong and whose principles I fully embrace and represent. Today I return to my responsibilities as Governor of Sinaloa with a clear conscience, my head held high, and the truth on my side." The U.S. State Department, Mexico's Attorney General's Office and the Mexican presidency did not immediately respond to requests for comment. RARE CHARGES AGAINST GOVERNOR In April, U.S. prosecutors alleged Rocha and nine other current and former officials conspired with a faction of the Sinaloa Cartel known as Los Chapitos, helping it traffic drugs into the United States in exchange for political support and bribes. The indictment marked a rare expansion of anti-cartel action beyond drug bosses to include a sitting senior Mexican politician. Washington has frequently accused Mexican politicians of having ties to organized crime, but Rocha is the first sitting governor to face charges by the U.S. The accusations inflamed tensions between the countries, which are close allies. Even as Mexican authorities initiated their own investigation into Rocha in early May, Sheinbaum framed the case as [USN:L1N4290RL TEXT:"foreign interference"] by the U.S. and used it to intensify her calls for national sovereignty. Since then, Mexico has said Washington had not provided sufficient evidence to justify Rocha's arrest or extradition. "It's difficult to imagine Rocha returning to office without President Sheinbaum's blessing. It's a sign that the government wants to reinforce its message that there is no evidence of collusion between Morena politicians and organized crime," said Antonio Ocaranza, a political consultant and former spokesperson for former Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo. "The big question is how the U.S. government will react to this decision." David Mora, a senior analyst for the International Crisis Group, said Rocha's return to power puts Sheinbaum in an "even more complicated position because now she's going to have to deal with more pressure coming from the U.S."

item.title: Soja tem alta "expressiva" no Brasil e atinge maior nível em mais de 3 anos, diz Cepea
item.description: Os preços da soja no mercado brasileiro registram alta "expressiva" de mais de 5% na última semana, atingindo o maior nível nominal desde abril de 2023 no Paraná, em momento de entressafra e forte procura para processamento no país e exportação, avaliou nesta sexta-feira o centro de estudos Cepea.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os preços da soja no mercado brasileiro registram alta "expressiva" de mais de 5% na última semana, atingindo o maior nível nominal desde abril de 2023 no Paraná, em momento de entressafra e forte procura para processamento no país e exportação, avaliou nesta sexta-feira o centro de estudos Cepea. Além disso, houve retração de vendedores, de olho em riscos climáticos do [USN:L1N44H12A TEXT:"El Niño"] para a próxima safra no Brasil e nas condições de desenvolvimento das lavouras nos Estados Unidos. "Esse cenário elevou a disputa pelo produto brasileiro", disse o Centro de Estudos Avançados em Economia Aplicada (Cepea). Os indicadores de preços Cepea/Esalq Paranaguá e Paraná subiram aos maiores patamares nominais diários desde abril de 2023, com o primeiro se aproximando de [USN:IGB7A6176 TEXT:"R$155"] a saca de 60 kg. De 13 a 20 de agosto, o indicador em Paranaguá avançou 5,2%, enquanto no Paraná subiu 4,5%. Na média das regiões acompanhadas pelo Cepea, os preços da soja subiram 3,8% no mercado de balcão (valor pago ao produtor) e 3% no mercado de lotes (negociações entre empresas). A demanda externa segue aquecida, sobretudo da China. No mercado doméstico, indústrias brasileiras vêm intensificando as aquisições para recompor e garantir os estoques, apontou o centro da Esalq/USP.

item.title: Reports: Marc Stad purchases lead stake in Wolves, Lynx
item.description: Marc Stad has completed a deal to become the controlling owner of the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Minnesota Lynx by purchasing the majority of co-owner Marc Lore's stake at a $4.5 billion valuation, multiple media outlets reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Marc Stad has completed a deal to become the controlling owner of the NBA's Minnesota Timberwolves and WNBA's Minnesota Lynx by purchasing the majority of co-owner Marc Lore's stake at a $4.5 billion valuation, multiple media outlets reported on Friday. Stad, the founder and managing partner of Dragoneer Investment Group, has been a minority investor in both basketball teams under the ownership group of Lore and Alex Rodriguez. "We have been working together for years with a shared goal of building the Timberwolves and Lynx into the best organization in basketball on and off the floor," Stad, Rodriguez and Lore said in their joint statement, per Front Office Sports. "Our priority is and always will be championships. Our new agreement, pending league approval, is an evolution of the partnership we have built together and strengthening of our commitment to our team and our culture. We will continue to work closely with (Timberwolves, Lynx CEO) Matt Caldwell, (Timberwolves president) Tim Connelly, (Wolves head coach) Chris Finch and (Lynx president and head coach) Cheryl Reeve and want to thank the fans and entire Minnesota community for your continued support. While we're proud of the great work we've done, there's so much more to do and we're just getting started." The reported deal will need approval from the NBA Board of Governors, which has its next meeting on Sept. 15-16. Per reports, Stad's wife, Elisa, will serve as the Timberwolves' governor and Rodriguez will remain a co-owner of both teams. Lore, in turn, will move into a limited role in the ownership group. Per The Athletic, he is stepping away from his role as governor to focus on taking his food delivery and takeout business, the Wonder Group, public. The reported transaction comes approximately 14 months after Lore and Rodriguez assumed full control of the Timberwolves and Lynx from previous owner Glen Taylor. Lore and Rodriguez bought into the Wolves in 2021 at a $1.5 billion valuation, with an agreement to purchase the team in full from Taylor. Taylor bought the club in 1994 for $88 million. --Field Level Media

Aug 21 : Shakhtar Donetsk will play their home matches in the Champions League's league phase at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge this season, both clubs announced on Friday. The Ukrainian champions have been unable to use their Donbas Arena since Russian-backed forces entered the region in 2014 and were further displaced by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Since leaving Donetsk, Shakhtar have played domestic matches in Kyiv and Lviv, while hosting European fixtures in Hamburg, Warsaw, Gelsenkirchen, Krakow and Ljubljana. The move to London comes after Chelsea failed to qualify for European competition following a 10th-placed Premier League finish last season, leaving Stamford Bridge available for Shakhtar's Champions League campaign.

"We are grateful to Chelsea Football Club for the opportunity to host our games at this special venue," Shakhtar said in a statement. "Stamford Bridge is one of the most famous stadiums in world football, with an incredible history and atmosphere. "We are convinced that Shakhtar's matches in London will provide unforgettable emotions for Ukrainian and English fans." Chelsea were formerly owned by Russian oligarch Roman Abramovich, who was sanctioned by the UK government following Moscow's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, triggering the sale of the club to a group led by American investor Todd Boehly and Clearlake Capital. Stamford Bridge has a capacity of around 40,000. "Shakhtar have played in countries across Europe and we look forward to welcoming them to London for their Champions League campaign this year," Chelsea said. "We will be working closely with the Shakhtar team over the coming weeks to ensure that matchdays run safely and smoothly for their team and supporters."

item.title: ウクライナ支援「有志連合」、24日に会合 ウ独立記念日
item.description: [パリ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２１日 ロイター] - ウクライナ支援国で構成する「有志連合」は、ウクライナの独立記念日に当たる２４日にキーウで会合を開催する。

フランス大統領府によると、ゼレンスキー大統領が出席し、マクロン仏大統領、バーナム英首相、メルツ独首相が共同議長を務める。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）のコスタ大統領も出席する。北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）によると、シェケリンスカ副事務総長がオンライン形式で参加する。

仏大統領府は声明で「ウクライナがロシアの侵攻から自国を守れるよう、ウクライナへの支援を強化するという決意を改めて表明するだろう」とした。

item.title: 英裁判所、ヘンリー王子らに計954万ポンド支払い命令 プライバシー訴訟敗訴で
item.description:
Michael Holden William James
［ロンドン ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Michael Holden　William James

［ロンドン　２１日　ロイター］ - 英高等法院は２１日、ヘンリー王子や歌手のエルトン・ジョンさんらに対し、大衆紙デーリー・メールなどの発行元に９５４万ポンド（約１３００万ドル）を支払うよう命じた。プライバシー侵害を巡り原告側が７月に敗訴していた訴訟について、原告側の進め方が不当だったと判断した。

英高等法院のニックリン判事は同日公表された判決で、英大衆紙デーリー・メールの発行元アソシエーテッド・ニュースペーパーズ・リミテッド側の弁護士費用として９５４万ポンドを８月２８日までに暫定的に支払うよう原告らに命じた。

さらにニックリン判事は、追加費用は「補償方式」で支払うべきだと判断。これはアソシエーテッド社が費用が合理的かつ相応であったことを証明する必要はないことを意味する。同判事は先月、ヘンリー王子やエルトン・ジョンさんら７人が起こした訴訟について、電話盗聴などデーリー・メール紙による広範な違法行為があったとする主張を退けていた。

アソシエーテッド社への支払総額はこの日は公表されなかった。当事者間で合意に至らない場合、同社の費用は別途の手続きで算定されることになる。

王子は６年前に王室公務から退き、米国に移住していたが、今月、妻のメーガン妃とともに英国に帰国する計画だと、複数のメディアが１９日に報じていた。

item.title: Gobernador mexicano acusado por EEUU de vínculos con narco regresa a su cargo
item.description: El gobernador del estado mexicano Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, regresó el viernes a su cargo tras una licencia de más de tres meses a raíz de las acusaciones de narcotráfico presentadas por Estados Unidos, que alegan vínculos con el Cártel de Sinaloa, en una medida que, según analistas, podría exacerbar las tensiones entre los países vecinos.
item.dc:creator: Diego Oré
item.content:encoded: El gobernador del estado mexicano Sinaloa, Rubén Rocha, regresó el viernes a su cargo tras una licencia de más de tres meses a raíz de las acusaciones de narcotráfico presentadas por Estados Unidos, que alegan vínculos con el Cártel de Sinaloa, en una medida que, según analistas, podría exacerbar las tensiones entre los países vecinos. Rocha, de 77 años y miembro del gobernante partido Morena, dijo que retomaba sus funciones luego de que las autoridades mexicanas no encontraran pruebas que respaldaran las acusaciones en su contra. En un comunicado publicado en X, el funcionario, quien se [USN:L6N41F05Q TEXT:"apartó temporalmente"] del cargo a principios de mayo, negó haber cometido delito alguno y calificó el caso estadounidense como un ataque con motivaciones políticas contra la soberanía de México y contra el movimiento de izquierda liderado por la presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum. "Durante el lapso que comprendió mi licencia temporal del cargo (...) me puse a la orden del sistema de justicia de nuestro país para ser investigado de las falsas acusaciones, que con motivaciones políticas e injerencistas de la ultraderecha nacional y extranjera, me hiciera sin ninguna prueba, una oficina del gobierno de Estados Unidos, pretendiendo lesionar con sus dichos y calumnias nuestra soberanía nacional", dijo Rocha. "Sin escudarme en el fuero constitucional propio de mi investidura, a cuya protección renuncié por personal convicción, me sometí a la acción de investigación de todas las instituciones competentes del Estado mexicano", agregó. "Después de 112 días de investigación (...) no existen los mínimos elementos de prueba que sustenten nuestra participación en conducta penal alguna (...) soy ajeno e inocente de las patrañas que se han urdido en mi contra". El Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. La Presidencia de México y la fiscalía general tampoco respondieron a solicitudes de Reuters. México se ha negado hasta el momento a actuar ante los esfuerzos estadounidenses para detener a Rocha, argumentando que Washington no presentó pruebas suficientes para justificar órdenes de arresto o extradición. Para los funcionarios estadounidenses, la acusación [USN:L6N41C18T TEXT:"de abril"] marcó una inusual ampliación de la acción contra los cárteles, que ahora incluye a un alto cargo político mexicano. El regreso de Rocha pone de manifiesto los límites de la cooperación bilateral en materia de seguridad: a pesar de años de esfuerzos conjuntos contra los cárteles, México sigue mostrándose profundamente reacio a las acciones estadounidenses que considera una injerencia en su soberanía. Los fiscales estadounidenses alegaron que Rocha y otros nueve funcionarios, tanto en activo como retirados, conspiraron con una facción del Cártel de Sinaloa conocida como "Los Chapitos", ayudándola a traficar drogas a Estados Unidos a cambio de apoyo político y sobornos. "Es difícil pensar que Rocha haya regresado a su posición sin el beneplácito de la presidenta", opinó Antonio Ocaranza, consultor y exportavoz del expresidente Ernesto Zedillo, quien gobernó México de 1994 a 2000. "Es una señal de que el Gobierno busca reforzar su mensaje de que no hay pruebas de que haya una colusión entre políticos de Morena y el crimen organizado". "La gran incógnita es cómo tomará el gobierno de Estados Unidos esta decisión", agregó Ocaranza, mencionando que, en las últimas dos semanas, dos personalidades de Morena han tomado decisiones que "complican" la relación entre Washington y Ciudad de México, haciendo referencia a una carta publicada por un hijo del expresidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador donde asegura que Estados Unidos le [USN:L6N44B0VX TEXT:"revocó la visa"] y los acusó de una "burda y perversa canallada". [USN:L6N3VV0W6 TEXT:"Reuters reportó"] el año pasado que Washington había revocado las visas de al menos 50 políticos y funcionarios mexicanos, en medio de la ofensiva de la administración de Donald Trump contra los cárteles de la droga y sus presuntos aliados políticos. David Mora, analista del International Crisis Group, afirmó que el regreso de Rocha al poder coloca a Sheinbaum en una "posición aún más complicada, porque ahora tendrá que lidiar con una mayor presión por parte de Estados Unidos".

item.title: Ataque duplo russo contra shopping center na Ucrânia mata 14 pessoas
item.description: Pelo menos 14 pessoas morreram e mais de 120 ficaram feridas nesta sexta-feira, quando dois drones russos atingiram um shopping center na cidade de Kryvyi Rih, no centro da Ucrânia, informaram as autoridades.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pelo menos 14 pessoas morreram e mais de 120 ficaram feridas nesta sexta-feira, quando dois drones russos atingiram um shopping center na cidade de Kryvyi Rih, no centro da Ucrânia, informaram as autoridades. Vinte e duas crianças estavam entre os feridos no ataque ocorrido durante o dia na cidade natal do presidente Volodymyr Zelenskiy, informou o governador regional Oleksandr Hanzha pelo aplicativo de mensagens Telegram. “Há 29 pessoas em estado grave, incluindo cinco crianças”, disse ele. Ele postou uma foto de fumaça preta subindo de um grande prédio industrial. Zelenskiy classificou o ataque como “absolutamente cínico e desprezível”, afirmando que um segundo drone russo atingiu o shopping center meia hora após o primeiro, em uma tentativa deliberada de atingir os serviços de emergência. “Ataques como esses são nada menos do que atos terroristas”, disse Zelenskiy no Telegram, instando o mundo a responsabilizar a Rússia. A Rússia está intensificando sua guerra aérea contra a Ucrânia, à medida que os combates no campo de batalha se aproximam da marca de quatro anos e meio. Na quinta-feira, 17 pessoas morreram em um ataque com mísseis balísticos russos contra a capital ucraniana, Kiev. A Ucrânia também intensificou seus próprios ataques contra a Rússia, visando instalações petrolíferas e infraestrutura logística para tentar minar a capacidade de Moscou de conduzir a guerra.

item.title: Doble ataque ruso contra un centro comercial en Ucrania deja 14 muertos
item.description: Al menos 14 personas murieron y más de 120 resultaron heridas el viernes, cuando dos drones rusos atacaron un centro comercial en la ciudad de Krivói Rog, en el centro de Ucrania, según informaron las autoridades locales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Al menos 14 personas murieron y más de 120 resultaron heridas el viernes, cuando dos drones rusos atacaron un centro comercial en la ciudad de Krivói Rog, en el centro de Ucrania, según informaron las autoridades locales. Entre los heridos en el ataque, que tuvo lugar durante el día en la ciudad natal del presidente Volodímir Zelenski, hay 22 niños, según informó el gobernador regional, Oleksandr Hanzha, a través de la aplicación de mensajería Telegram. "Hay 29 personas en estado grave, entre ellas cinco niños", dijo. Publicó una foto en la que se veía humo negro saliendo a borbotones de un gran edificio industrial. Zelenski calificó el ataque de "absolutamente cínico y despreciable", y señaló que un segundo dron ruso impactó contra el centro comercial media hora después del primero, en un intento deliberado de atacar a los servicios de emergencia. "Ataques como estos no son más que actos terroristas", declaró Zelenski en Telegram, instando al mundo a exigir responsabilidades a Rusia. Rusia está intensificando su guerra aérea contra Ucrania a medida que los combates en el campo de batalla se acercan a los cuatro años y medio de conflicto. El jueves, 17 personas perdieron la vida en un ataque con misiles balísticos rusos contra la capital ucraniana, Kiev. Ucrania también ha intensificado sus propios ataques contra Rusia, dirigiéndose contra instalaciones petroleras e infraestructuras logísticas para intentar socavar la capacidad de Moscú para librar la guerra.

LONDON/NEW YORK, Aug 21 : Vista Equity Partners is weighing a potential sale of Allvue Systems, in a deal that could value the provider of data and analytics for asset managers and credit investors at as much as $3 billion including debt, four people familiar with the matter said. The move comes almost five years since Allvue's efforts to list via an initial public offering on the New York Stock Exchange were thwarted by the end of a bull run in financial technology stocks in the fall of 2021. While many companies have struggled with subdued investor interest and depressed valuations in the years since, 2026 has seen a recovery in deal-making efforts involving specialized financial technology and data providers which have businesses resilient to the growth of artificial intelligence. Against this more positive backdrop, Vista has engaged bankers at Evercore and Barclays to explore sale options for the Miami-headquartered Allvue, whose products help manage investments, track performance and streamline back-office operations.

Discussions with potential buyers are at an early stage, said the sources who cautioned that no deal was guaranteed and spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss confidential information. Vista and Barclays declined comment. Allvue and Evercore did not respond to comment requests. Vista formed Allvue Systems in 2019 by acquiring AltaReturn and merging it with its existing portfolio company, Black Mountain Systems. The company has since expanded through acquisitions, including private markets software firm PFA Solutions in 2024. Allvue now generates more than $200 million in annual recurring revenue, one of the people said. Allvue could fetch somewhere between $2 billion and $3 billion in the event of a sale, said the person and a further source, based on the firm’s annual growth rate of more than 15 per cent, margins exceeding 30 per cent, and valuations achieved by comparable companies in the sectors. By comparison, when Vista pulled Allvue's IPO in September 2021, it was seeking a valuation of around $1.7 billion. As well as broader sector tailwinds, Allvue should benefit from perceived scarcity value, given few of its peers are not already inside large financial institutions. For example, BlackRock completed its £2.55 billion ($3.5 billion) acquisition of Preqin in March 2025.

Source: Reuters
